children: Global analytics software leader,
FICO

, today announced that Informative Research is making the FICO® Preferred Program available to its mortgage lender clients in 2027, broadening access to FICO’s new pricing model and giving lenders another way to obtain the FICO® Scores used throughout the mortgage lending process.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261123235219/en/

Under the FICO Preferred Program, participating lenders receive both the Classic FICO® Score and FICO® Score 10T for a flat $10 wholesale price per score bundle, including two FICO Scores: Classic FICO Score, trusted by the mortgage finance ecosystem for nearly three decades, and FICO Score 10T, the mortgage industry’s most predictive credit score.
“Our clients look to Informative Research to help them navigate an increasingly dynamic mortgage market,” said
Matt Orlando, President at Informative Research

. “That means continually expanding the solutions available to them and rapidly enabling our customers to respond to industry changes. Distributing the FICO Score under the FICO Preferred Program to our end users gives lenders and brokers another valuable option for using FICO Scores to support their lending strategies and the borrowers they serve.”

FICO Scores help lenders more precisely assess credit risk, supporting loan terms that better reflect each borrower’s credit profile and the safety and soundness of the housing finance system. That precision can save borrowers more than $3,500 per loan while improving secondary market execution. Beginning January 1, 2027, FHA’s acceptance of FICO® Score 10T will open the door for broader use of the score in mortgage lending, with Informative Research clients able to access and use FICO Score 10T alongside Classic FICO Score through the FICO Preferred Program.
“Informative Research has been a strong partner in helping move the mortgage industry forward,” said
Julie May, President of B2B Scores at FICO

. “Their commitment to giving lenders more options aligns closely with what we set out to achieve with our new pricing models. Together, we’re helping create an environment where lenders can take advantage of innovation in credit scoring, including FICO Score 10T, to support sustainable homeownership.”
Lenders interested in the FICO Preferred Program through Informative Research can contact their Informative Research representative for additional information.
For more information about the FICO Preferred Program, visit
https://www.ficoscore.com/fico-preferred-program
About FICO
FICO (

) powers decisions that help people and businesses around the world prosper. Founded in 1956, the company is a pioneer in the use of predictive analytics and data science to improve operational decisions. FICO holds more than 200 U.S. and foreign patents on technologies that increase profitability, customer satisfaction and growth for businesses in financial services, insurance, telecommunications, health care, retail and many other industries. Using FICO solutions, businesses in more than 70 countries do everything from protecting 4 billion payment cards from fraud, to improving financial inclusion, to increasing supply chain resiliency. The FICO® Score, used by 90% of top U.S. lenders, is the standard measure of consumer credit risk in the U.S. and has been made available in over 40 other countries, improving risk management, credit access and transparency.
Learn more at https://www.fico.com.
About Informative Research

Informative Research, a Stewart company, is a premier technology provider delivering data-driven credit and verification solutions to the lending community. The solutions provider currently serves mortgage companies, banks and lenders throughout the United States. The company is recognized for streamlining the loan process with its straightforward service model, progressive solutions and cutting-edge technology. To learn more, visit https://www.informativeresearch.com.
